findings.description: At 01:12 two separate white mugs are on the counter: one held by the man and one held by the waitress just beside it. By 01:13 in the same continuous shot only one mug remains, held by both of them. No mug is lifted away or set aside, so one container vanishes or the two merge into one.

Before the pour (00:27.1) the carafe holds dark coffee in about the lower half of its globe. After roughly three seconds of steady pouring into a full-size mug (00:28-00:30.75), the carafe at 00:31 looks just as full, with no clear drop. The camera angle and carafe tilt differ between these frames, so this is low confidence.
